channel.title: Rebound.org Blog
channel.description: Practical, sourced articles on rebound congestion and getting off decongestant nasal sprays.

item.title: Oxymetazoline plus a steroid spray: does the combination prevent rebound?
item.description: A 2026 review found a steroid + oxymetazoline spray eased allergic congestion for up to 28 days without significant rebound. What it shows, and its limits.

item.title: Afrin withdrawal relief: 10 things that actually help
item.description: What helps during Afrin withdrawal: a steroid nasal spray, saline rinses, humidity and sleeping elevated, plus four things that make rebound congestion worse.

item.title: How long can you safely use Afrin? The 3-day rule, explained
item.description: Afrin's label says no more than 3 days. Here's why, what US and UK regulators say, what counts toward the limit, and what to do if you've used it longer.

item.title: Afrin alternatives: what to use instead of a decongestant spray
item.description: Seven alternatives to Afrin that do not cause rebound congestion: steroid and antihistamine sprays, saline, oral options and non-drug fixes, and how to choose.

item.title: 12 myths about Afrin and rebound congestion, debunked
item.description: Is Flonase addictive too? Does switching brands help? Is night-only use safe? Twelve myths about Afrin and rebound congestion, checked against the evidence.

item.title: When to see an ENT for rebound congestion
item.description: Red flags that mean it's time to see an ENT about nasal spray dependence, what happens at the appointment, the treatments they can offer and questions to ask.

item.title: Turbinate reduction for rebound congestion: when surgery makes sense
item.description: Most people recover from rebound congestion without surgery. When turbinate reduction is considered, what two 2024 studies found, and the risks to weigh.

item.title: How to stay off Afrin: a plan for your next cold
item.description: After rebound congestion, one 'just this once' spray can bring it back fast. A simple relapse-prevention plan for colds, flights and allergy season.
